item.title: Undertone 1.35.4
item.description:
• Pro and Business include Undertone's AI with no credits to count, within a generous monthly fair use. Settings shows "Undertone AI included", and the sidebar no longer shows a credit balance on paid plans.
  • Credit packs are for the free plan only, so paid plans no longer see "Get more credits".

Undertone 1.35.3

  • Invite teammates from the Team page. Click Invite… (or Invite people… under People) to add emails, pick a role and see pending invites and join requests, without going to Settings.

Undertone 1.35.2

  • The sidebar shows your plan (Free, Pro or Business). On Free, an Upgrade button shows what Pro adds.
  • Automatic briefings now show up on the meeting even when Up next reads it from a different calendar than the one the briefing was written from, so "Brief me" no longer appears for a meeting that's already briefed.
  • "Review now" on Home says when there's nothing new to learn instead of doing nothing.

Undertone 1.35.1

  • Recipes use the whole window: cards flow into as many columns as fit, and category pills (All, Across your week, Customers, Sales…) filter the library instead of half-empty sections.
  • Cards are more compact, with the category shown on each one; hover for Run and the preview button.

Undertone 1.35.0

Undertone is out of beta.

  • Free stays free: live hints, recaps, tasks, glossary and Ask, with free credits to start or the AI you already use.
  • Pro ($10 a month billed yearly, or $12 monthly) adds automatic briefings, full history, sync across your Macs and daily learning. Get it from Settings › Pro or getundertone.app/pro.
  • Business ($20 per person a month billed yearly, or $24 monthly) brings Pro to your whole team, plus team insights and more seats.
  • Thank you to everyone who tried the beta and sent feedback.
